Best Tap and Die Sets

A tap cuts threads inside a hole. A die cuts threads on a rod. Buy the wrong set and the tap snaps off in the hole, which is a broken bolt you cannot grab with anything. From a $6 single tap to a $145 ratcheting set, here is what decides whether the threads come out clean.
